chimneyReviewNotes: 54 symbols traced across 19 registered site groups from July 1893 originals. Source pixels and height readings retained. Supplied 1926 symbol key is interpretive support, not the survey date. Gasworks and remaining OS-only sites still need chimney evidence reviewed. One provisional Bromley boiler stack subsequently added from OS / 1924 aerial comparison. The 1902 northward photo also shows foreground chemical-works stacks; not all are gasworks stacks. Bromley retort houses now have 24 interpreted roof flues informed by the 1924 aerials; estimated arrangements follow the author’s close-enough reconstruction preference.
